521     # Instruct
  522     @battle.allBattlers.each do |b|
  523       next if !b.effects[PBEffects::Instruct] || !b.lastMoveUsed
  524       b.effects[PBEffects::Instruct] = false
  525       idxMove = -1
  526       b.eachMoveWithIndex { |m, i| idxMove = i if m.id == b.lastMoveUsed }
  527       next if idxMove < 0
  528       oldLastRoundMoved = b.lastRoundMoved
  529       @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1} used the move instructed by {2}!", b.pbThis, user.pbThis(true)))
  530       b.effects[PBEffects::Instructed] = true
  531       if b.pbCanChooseMove?(b.moves[idxMove], false)
  532         PBDebug.logonerr do
  533           b.pbUseMoveSimple(b.lastMoveUsed, b.lastRegularMoveTarget, idxMove, false)
  534         end
  535         b.lastRoundMoved = oldLastRoundMoved
  536         @battle.pbJudge
  537         return if @battle.decision > 0
  538       end
  539       b.effects[PBEffects::Instructed] = false
  540     end
  541     # Dancer
  542     if !@effects[PBEffects::Dancer] && !user.lastMoveFailed && realNumHits > 0 &&
  543        !move.snatched && magicCoater < 0 && @battle.pbCheckGlobalAbility(:DANCER) &&
  544        move.danceMove?
  545       dancers = []
  546       @battle.pbPriority(true).each do |b|
  547         dancers.push(b) if b.index != user.index && b.hasActiveAbility?(:DANCER)
  548       end
  549       while dancers.length > 0
  550         nextUser = dancers.pop
  551         oldLastRoundMoved = nextUser.lastRoundMoved
  552         # NOTE: Petal Dance being used because of Dancer shouldn't lock the
  553         #       Dancer into using that move, and shouldn't contribute to its
  554         #       turn counter if it's already locked into Petal Dance.
  555         oldOutrage = nextUser.effects[PBEffects::Outrage]
  556         nextUser.effects[PBEffects::Outrage] += 1 if nextUser.effects[PBEffects::Outrage] > 0
  557         oldCurrentMove = nextUser.currentMove
  558         preTarget = choice[3]
  559         preTarget = user.index if nextUser.opposes?(user) || !nextUser.opposes?(preTarget)
  560         @battle.pbShowAbilitySplash(nextUser, true)
  561         @battle.pbHideAbilitySplash(nextUser)
  562         if !Battle::Scene::USE_ABILITY_SPLASH
  563           @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1} kept the dance going with {2}!",
  564                                   nextUser.pbThis, nextUser.abilityName))
  565         end
  566         nextUser.effects[PBEffects::Dancer] = true
  567         if nextUser.pbCanChooseMove?(move, false)
  568           PBDebug.logonerr { nextUser.pbUseMoveSimple(move.id, preTarget) }
  569           nextUser.lastRoundMoved = oldLastRoundMoved
  570           nextUser.effects[PBEffects::Outrage] = oldOutrage
  571           nextUser.currentMove = oldCurrentMove
  572           @battle.pbJudge
  573           return if @battle.decision > 0
  574         end
  575         nextUser.effects[PBEffects::Dancer] = false
  576       end
  577     end
  578   end
